text:
Ari (Marketing): quick ask for next Tue launch: compact benchmark hero + webinar frame + 1:1 social gif. Need credibility-first visuals for landing + ads.
Sam (Design): list of deliverables?
Ari (Marketing): hero static 1200x628, webinar frame 1920x1080 (title-safe 150px), gif 1:1 1080x1080 ~3s loop (animated CTA pulse), slide template 16:9 Figma. Provide logo-left and centered variants.
Rae (Creative Ops): please include figma source, export tokens, EN/FR/DE placeholders. Leave extra width for DE. Tagging legal for any numeric claims.
ExportBot: checklist: PNG @2x, SVG icons, GIF optimized (gifsicle --optimize=3). Contrast >=4.5:1. Alt text required.
Jules (Growth): CTAs for A/B: "See the numbers" / "Register — seats limited". GIF should be 3-frame loop, 12fps, pulse on frame 2.
Sam (Design): style: data-forward (sparklines + metric pills) with small illustrative accent. Mock by Thu EOD, final by Mon AM PST. Uploading WIP to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/mini-bench-pack
Ari (Marketing): great — if legal flags claims we switch to relative language and add 12px footnote for methodology. Escalate blockers here. :thumbsup:
